name: @tea-fabrika/trace
description: A program with a window: one job's trace, read from its record, or one ticket's lanes, read from its facts. A job: a waterfall of spans nested by parent, one color per program, every grouped row opening down to one step. A ticket: each lane on its own axis, its steps and waits on a person, each step opening to its spans, and a replay to any fact.
